reviews.text: Finding a cleanser that leaves mature skin feeling refreshed without stripping away essential moisture is rare, but the Anua 8 Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Gentle Gel Cleanser delivers. The lightweight gel texture glides smoothly over the skin, melting away impurities while keeping delicate, dry areas completely comfortable. Thanks to the hyaluronic acid blend, skin feels soft, plump, and deeply hydrated post-rinse—never tight, dry, or irritated. An absolute staple for a gentle, moisture-rich daily cleanse!
reviews.zh: 要搵一款潔面產品，可以令成熟肌膚清爽，又唔會洗走必需嘅水分，真係好難得，但係 Anua 8 Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Gentle Gel Cleanser 做到。輕盈嘅凝膠質地順滑咁喺皮膚上推開，溶走污垢，同時令乾燥嘅細嫩位置都保持舒適。得益於透明質酸配方，沖洗之後皮膚感覺柔軟、飽滿、深層補水，唔會緊繃、乾燥或者刺激。係溫和、滋潤嘅日常潔面必備品，絕對係必備之選！

reviews.text: I’ve really been enjoying this cleanser. The gel texture feels light and gentle on the skin, and it cleanses well without leaving my face feeling tight or stripped afterward. I especially like that my skin still feels comfortable and hydrated after rinsing, which isn’t always the case with cleansers. It’s a simple everyday cleanser that works nicely both morning and evening. Definitely a good option if you prefer a gentle, non-drying cleanser
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款潔面產品。凝膠質地輕盈、溫和，潔面效果好好，洗完之後面唔會覺得緊繃，亦唔會被洗走水分。我特別鍾意洗完之後皮膚仲係好舒服、水潤，呢點唔係每款潔面都做到。佢係一款簡單嘅日常潔面產品，朝早同晚上用都好好。如果你鍾意溫和、唔會令皮膚乾燥嘅潔面產品，呢款絕對係一個好選擇。

reviews.text:
I really liked this product and it worked perfectly for my skin. It provided deep hydration and kept my skin feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized throughout the day. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky feeling, which I really appreciate.

What impressed me the most is how gentle it is. My skin is quite sensitive, but this product did not cause any irritation, redness, or discomfort at all. Instead, it helped calm and soothe my skin, making it feel more balanced and comfortable.

After using it consistently, I noticed that my skin looks healthier, more refreshed, and well-hydrated. Overall, I’m very satisfied with this product and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for effective hydration without irritation
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款產品，啱我嘅皮膚。佢提供深層補水，成日都令皮膚柔軟、順滑、滋潤。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會有油膩或者黏膩嘅感覺，我好欣賞呢點。

最令我印象深刻嘅係佢好溫和。我嘅皮膚幾敏感，但係呢款產品完全冇令我出現刺激、發紅或者不適。反而幫助舒緩皮膚，令皮膚感覺更加平衡、舒服。

持續用咗之後，我發現皮膚睇落更健康、更清爽，水分充足。總括嚟講，我好滿意呢款產品，如果你想要有效補水又唔刺激嘅產品，我一定會推薦畀你。

reviews.text: The Anua hyaluronic acid gel cleanser is great Korean cleanser that I absolutely recommend! It's gentle, with low-pH that doesn’t strip the skin. On the contrary, my skin feels soft, hydrated and comfortable after every washing. It's perfect for daily use. The gel texture that foams well and a pea size amount of it is enough for one wash for me - one bottle will be enough for long time!!
reviews.zh: Anua 透明質酸凝膠潔面產品係一款好好嘅韓國潔面產品，我絕對推薦！佢好溫和，低 pH 值，唔會剝走皮膚嘅水分。相反，每次洗完之後，我嘅皮膚都感覺柔軟、水潤、舒服。日常用就啱晒。凝膠質地起泡效果好，我每次用一粒豌豆大小嘅份量就夠晒洗一次，一支可以用好耐！！

reviews.text: I have been using only one cleanser for years now (cosrx low ph), but lately my skin has become dry and more prone to irritation. So I wanted to try out a new hydrating cleanser for the morning and have been very satisfied. it's now stripping, forms a foam that is thicker than a usual gel cleanser and leaves the skin clean and soft
reviews.zh: 我用咗同一款潔面（cosrx low ph）好多年，但係最近皮膚變得乾身，亦更加容易受刺激。所以我想試吓一款新嘅補水潔面，用嚟朝早用，而家都好滿意。佢唔會剝走水分，起嘅泡比一般凝膠潔面厚身，令皮膚保持乾淨、柔軟。

reviews.text: The Anua 8 Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Gentle Gel Cleanser is a great everyday cleanser. It feels super gentle on the skin and doesn’t leave it feeling tight or stripped. I love how it lathers softly and keeps my skin feeling clean, calm, and hydrated. It didn’t break me out, and the multiple hyaluronic acids really help lock in moisture after washing.
reviews.zh: Anua 8 Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Gentle Gel Cleanser 係一款好好嘅日常潔面產品。塗喺皮膚上非常溫和，洗完唔會覺得緊繃或者被洗走水分。我好鍾意佢起泡柔和，令皮膚保持清爽、平靜、水潤。用咗都冇令我爆痘，而且多種透明質酸真係有助洗完之後鎖住水分。

reviews.text: I haven't used the product yet because I'm waiting till my other cleanser is empty but I already know it's a good product (sounds like I'm a scammer but I'm not hihi). It is fungal acne safe and acne safe and it has hyaluronic acid ingredients which will be perfect for my damaged skin! I love Anua in general so I think (99%) I will purchase this again!
reviews.zh: 我未用過呢款產品，因為要等我而家用緊嘅另一款潔面用完先，不過我已經知道佢係好產品（聽落好似我係騙子咁，但我唔係 hihi）。佢係真菌痘安全，亦係暗瘡安全，而且含有透明質酸成分，對我受損嘅皮膚會好啱！我一般都好鍾意 Anua，所以我諗（99%）我會再買呢款。

reviews.text:
This is my new current fav. 
It works well to my sensitive skin. Leaving the skin moisturized.
It foams up really good, creates gentle foam.
Makes my skin clean and smooth.
It contains Squalane and Ceramide NP which is perfect for skin barrier.
Good for rosacea, couperose and redness. FA safe!
So what more could you wish for :)
100/10
reviews.zh:
呢款係我而家嘅新寵。
對我敏感嘅皮膚都好好，令皮膚保持水潤。
起泡效果好好，泡沫溫和。
令我嘅皮膚清爽、幼滑。
含有角鯊烷同 Ceramide NP，對皮膚屏障好啱。
適合酒糟、紅血絲 (couperose) 同泛紅。FA 安全！
仲有咩好嘢可以再期望呢 :)
100/10
